$doc: Every route the visual-regression suite screenshots, at every viewport in playwright.config.ts. Data, not code — adding a route to the app means adding a line here, and `routes.spec.ts` fails if a `+page.svelte` exists with no entry, so the list cannot silently fall behind.
$paths: Concrete URLs resolved against the committed fixture in tests/ui/fixtures (see its README for the ids). Keep them pinned: a screenshot of whatever happens to be row 1 is not a baseline.

$fields.id: baseline filename stem — stable, kebab-case; renaming it orphans a PNG
$fields.about: what this route is, for whoever reads a failure
$fields.waitFor: optional CSS selector that must be visible before the shot
$fields.mask: optional selectors painted over — for genuinely non-deterministic pixels only, never to hide a diff you don't feel like reviewing
$fields.fullPage: optional, defaults true. Set false for a route that renders a WINDOW of its content — a virtually-scrolled list is as tall as the whole result and draws only what is on screen, so a full-page shot is mostly the blank the scroller has not drawn yet

unrepresented.routes/bundles/[slug]/+page.svelte: Redirect-only shim to /browse/[code] (pokedumpster-80q). It renders one line of placeholder text before navigating; the destination is already covered by browse-set.

Binder page for the Japanese set — the render a NULL printed_total and TCGCSV-only art produce: every card filed as base rather than as a secret rare, two print runs per slot, and one slot with no art at all (pd-zonm)
Master-set completion stats — charts and progress meters
Charizard ex — card detail with variants, prices and copies
Base Set Charizard — a card with an ordered copy in flight
Collection list — paints its own chrome, and renders a virtual window of the result
routes.$fullPage: The list is virtually scrolled (pd-7z4o): the document is as tall as every matching row, and only the rows under the viewport are in it. A full-page shot is therefore mostly the blank below the window, and its height moves with measured tile geometry — a baseline of that judges the scroller's arithmetic, not the design. The viewport is what a reader sees, so the viewport is what gets judged.

routes.$waitFor: The keyword and flag tables come from an onMount fetch, which can start AFTER networkidle — so without this, settle() returns while the page is still short and it then grows under the screenshot. This is not the whole of pd-832w's 2557-vs-2561 flake, though: that one survived this waitFor and was the capture itself relaying out the page. See the warm-up shot in stabilize.ts.
